newsitem.title: CHINA: China trekker drinks urine to cross "zone of death".
newsitem.headline: China trekker drinks urine to cross "zone of death".

text.p: Chinese explorer Li Yongsheng has made the first confirmed summer crossing of a desert "zone of death" in an epic trip in which he was forced to drink his own urine to survive, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Li took 40 days to walk alone across part of the Lop Nur desert in the remote region of Xinjiang, sheltering from 60 degree Celsius (140 Fahrenheit) temperatures during the day and travelling at night, the agency said.
At one point members of an oil exploration team rescued Li while while he was near death, and the dehydrated veteran hiker was forced to drink his own urine on two occasions, it said.
Searing temperatures of up to 70 degrees Celsius (158 Fahrenheit) in the desert, which is known as the "zone of death", killed explorer Yu Chunshun last year.

Li, a 35-year-old graduate of Beijing's Central Academy of Fine Arts, in 1989 set off on a journey to visit the homelands of all of China's 56 national minorities and had so far walked 94,000 km (60,000 miles), Xinhua said.
